title: Role of the Token (PNL)
subtitle: PNL is a coordination and participation mechanism within the PonyLife ecosystem — designed for accounting and alignment, not as an investment instrument.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The PonyLife token is a coordination and participation mechanism within the platform.
It is designed to support internal accounting, alignment of incentives, and shared experimentation — not to function as an investment instrument.

sections.heading: What the Token Represents
paragraphs: The token represents conditional participation within the PonyLife ecosystem.
bullets: Enable internal liquidity between ecosystem participants

sections.heading: What the Token Does Not Represent
bullets: A claim on guaranteed financial returns

sections.heading: Why a Token Is Used
paragraphs: Coordination at scale requires a native unit of participation.

The token enables transparent tracking of participation across many assets and actors, alignment between creators, operators, and promoters, and flexible experimentation with different coordination models.
Without a native participation unit, coordination remains opaque, centralized, or purely reputational.

sections.heading: Token Allocation Logic
paragraphs: Tokens may be allocated to creators based on internal, non-binding asset valuation.
This allocation reflects conditional participation, is used within the platform’s coordination framework, and may evolve as the ecosystem develops.
bullets: Allocation does not imply a market price for the asset
Allocation does not imply a guaranteed outcome
Allocation does not imply a promise of liquidity

sections.heading: Token Usage
paragraphs: Tokens can be used within the ecosystem for participation-related interactions, such as access to platform features, participation in coordinated initiatives, and internal exchange between ecosystem participants.
After specific outcomes are realized, allocated tokens become fully usable and participants are free to hold, use, or exchange them according to platform rules.

sections.heading: What the Token Is Not
paragraphs: The PonyLife token is explicitly not designed as a financial product.

sections.heading: Design Philosophy
paragraphs: The token exists to make coordination explicit, measurable, and composable.

Rather than promising returns, it enables experimentation with new forms of collective visibility, shared exposure to uncertainty, and transparent participation across a fragmented creative landscape.
